entries.df733a23f2ae2696: Since its founding in 1938, it has cultivated sewing technology centered on industrial sewing machines. Its Otawara Plant is its main plant, and it has a global production and sales structure consisting of overseas production bases in China and Vietnam and sales subsidiaries in the United States, Europe, Asia, China and India. Its strengths are the technological foundations of its two businesses, sewing and industrial machinery: its solution proposal capability through the integration of IoT into industrial sewing machines, and the implementation technology of its Industrial Equipment Business.
entries.e03773280f42efb2: Profit attributable to owners of parent for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,399 million, and the previous consolidated fiscal year recorded a net loss of ¥3,235 million.

entries.efb84a2ea30e9003: The company is promoting its five-year medium-term management plan, “Building Sustainable JUKI,” covering 2025 to 2029. Its basic policies are three: growth centered on its two businesses, strengthening cost competitiveness and financial base, and practicing ESG management. In the Sewing Business, it will accelerate locking in high-end customers through solution proposals that integrate IoT, and it will also expand household sewing machines. In the Industrial Machinery Business, the Industrial Equipment Business is shifting to a global niche strategy focused on priority areas and regions, and in the Contract Business it is strengthening the search for a third pillar by leveraging its technological capabilities. The medium-term management plan is to be reviewed every year.

entries.fad3b62a70ee24e5: As its industrial equipment business, it manufactures and sells mounters, peripheral equipment and IoT-related systems, and as its contract business, it manufactures and sells contract-processed products and components. Subsidiaries such as JUKI AUTOMATION SYSTEMS GMBH, JUKI Sanki Technology Co., Ltd., JUKI Aizu Co., Ltd. and JUKI Hiroshima Co., Ltd. are responsible for these businesses. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥21,847 million.
entries.fbe95ad99300e283: Industrial sewing machines and household sewing machines are produced at the Ōtawara plant and at domestic and overseas subsidiaries, while mounters and other industrial equipment, as well as contract-manufactured products and parts, are produced at subsidiaries in Akita, Fukushima, Hiroshima and others, and at subsidiaries in Vietnam and China.
entries.fdb14a238aed4cbe: The business model is one in which a group consisting of the company, 24 subsidiaries and three affiliates manufactures industrial sewing machines, mounters and others, sells them through domestic and overseas sales subsidiaries to sewing factories, electronic component manufacturers and others, and earns revenue from the sales proceeds.
